Joint Belgium/Luxembourg Fulbright commission is stored once under Belgium; Luxembourg applicant access does not imply an additional Luxembourg publisher.

Editorial source activity spans scholarships, paid doctoral positions, research internships, mobility, volunteering and youth arts grants; each has distinct eligibility.
The former KTU and RTU duplicate exclusions now have new evidence for their own independently managed institutional programmes; old national grants remain duplicates.

The legacy counts_toward_active_source_target flag measures recent editorial evidence, including closed annual calls. It never establishes current open-application or automated coverage; use the explicitly scoped country summary fields.

quality_summary.definition: Recent editorial activity includes primary 2026 application rounds or 2026/27 and 2027/28 programmes, including closed annual calls, internships, doctoral jobs, youth grants and volunteering. It does not imply currently open applications, three automated integrations per country, or reuse permission.
quality_summary.current_application_review_definition: Conservative snapshot based only on explicitly reviewed open_confirmed or some_calls_open examples, counting distinct operators and excluding duplicate evidence. Missing, conditional, conflicting or closed states are not counted. Zero means insufficient classified evidence, not proof no open opportunities exist.
quality_summary.independent_activity_count_definition: 94 sources have dated/cycle editorial evidence; 93 are eligible evidence entries after excluding the Croatian science ministry bilateral call co-published with AMPEU. Country totals then deduplicate operators. publisher_overlap refers to common operators, whereas exclusion_reason can also exclude a duplicated programme from a different operator.
